## Release Date: 2025-05-23

### New Features
- **UI Overhaul**: Redesigned user interface with modern aesthetics and improved usability.
- **Production Environment Features**:

  - Integrated real-time monitoring tools for production servers.
- **Script Enhancements**:
  - Optimized scripting engine for 30% faster execution.
  - Added new API endpoints for custom scripts.

### Bug Fixes
- Fixed crashes during high-load scenarios.
- Resolved alignment issues in the settings panel.
- Corrected data syncing errors with external services.

### Improvements
- Enhanced accessibility for keyboard navigation.
- Updated dependencies to latest stable versions.

For more details, see [our documentation](https://example.com/docs).
